title: InterventionPattern
description: A reusable, context-free building block for AI social behavior in group or private conversations.

id.description: Unique identifier for this pattern, used in EventTemplate goals arrays and conversation.goals.

description.description: What this pattern does and why it matters.

channel.description: Which channel this pattern operates in.

conditions.description: Observable conditions that should prompt considering this pattern.

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence score (0-100) required before triggering. Policy thresholds are floored by this value.

guardrails.description: Constraints the agent must respect when executing this pattern.

format.description: Output format. 'text' for standard chat messages; 'poll' for poll-based interventions.

pollConfig.description: Poll visibility and behaviour settings. Required when format is 'poll'.

pollInstructions.description: LLM instructions describing the goal and style of the poll. Required when format is 'poll'.

examples.description: Concrete example outputs demonstrating this pattern in practice.
